mapper.select: SELECT task_no,claim_version,scan_cursor,candidate_cursor,lease_until,last_error,created_at FROM settlement_task ORDER BY task_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_task(task_no,lease_owner) VALUES('SCAN','') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_no=task_no
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_task WHERE task_no='SCAN' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_task SET lease_owner=#{owner},claim_version=claim_version+1,lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE task_no='SCAN' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_task WHERE task_no='SCAN' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND claim_version=#{version} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_task SET scan_cursor=#{cursor},lease_until=NULL,last_error=#{error} WHERE task_no='SCAN' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND claim_version=#{version} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE settlement_task SET candidate_cursor=#{cursor} WHERE task_no='SCAN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_account(merchant_id) VALUES(#{merchant}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE merchant_id=merchant_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_account WHERE merchant_id=#{merchant} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM settlement_item WHERE payment_no=#{payment} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM settlement_fact WHERE kind=#{kind} AND business_no=#{business}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_item SET refund_cents=refund_cents+#{amount},fee_cents=#{fee} WHERE payment_no=#{payment} AND refund_cents+#{amount}<=paid_cents
UPDATE settlement_account SET debt_cents=debt_cents+#{delta} WHERE merchant_id=#{merchant} AND debt_cents+#{delta}>=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_item WHERE status='FROZEN' AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_item SET status='SIMULATED_COMPLETED',batch_no=#{batch} WHERE payment_no=#{payment} AND status='FROZEN'
mapper.select: SELECT i.payment_no,i.order_no,i.merchant_id,i.paid_cents,i.refund_cents,i.fee_cents,i.fee_bps,i.freeze_days,i.status,i.paid_cents-i.refund_cents-i.fee_cents AS current_net_cents,i.created_at,b.batch_no,b.net_cents AS batch_net_cents,b.simulated_payout_cents,b.debt_offset_cents,b.created_at AS simulated_completed_at FROM settlement_item i LEFT JOIN settlement_batch b ON b.payment_no=i.payment_no i.merchant_id=#{merchant} ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM ${table} merchant_id=#{merchant} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(principal_delta),0) AS principalCents,COALESCE(SUM(fee_delta),0) AS feeCents,COALESCE(SUM(payable_delta),0) AS payableCents,COALESCE(SUM(simulated_delta),0) AS simulatedCents,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debt_cents),0) FROM settlement_account merchant_id=#{merchant}) AS debtCents FROM settlement_ledger merchant_id=#{merchant}

SELECT i.payment_no,i.paid_cents,i.refund_cents,i.fee_cents FROM settlement_item i LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_no,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) paid,SUM(CASE WHEN kind='REFUND_SUCCEEDED' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) refunded FROM settlement_fact GROUP BY payment_no) f ON f.payment_no=i.payment_no LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_no,SUM(principal_delta) principal,SUM(fee_delta) fee,SUM(payable_delta) payable,SUM(simulated_delta) simulated FROM settlement_ledger GROUP BY payment_no) l ON l.payment_no=i.payment_no LEFT JOIN settlement_batch b ON b.payment_no=i.payment_no WHERE COALESCE(f.paid,0)!=i.paid_cents OR COALESCE(f.refunded,0)!=i.refund_cents OR COALESCE(l.principal,0)!=i.paid_cents-i.refund_cents OR COALESCE(l.fee,0)!=i.fee_cents OR i.fee_cents!=FLOOR((CAST(i.paid_cents AS DECIMAL(30,0))-i.refund_cents)*i.fee_bps/10000) OR COALESCE(l.principal,0)-COALESCE(l.fee,0)!=COALESCE(l.payable,0)+COALESCE(l.simulated,0) OR (i.status='SIMULATED_COMPLETED' AND b.id IS NULL) OR (i.status='FROZEN' AND b.id IS NOT NULL) OR (i.status='FROZEN' AND (COALESCE(l.payable,0)!=i.paid_cents-i.refund_cents-i.fee_cents OR COALESCE(l.simulated,0)!=0)) OR (i.status='SIMULATED_COMPLETED' AND (COALESCE(l.payable,0)!=0 OR COALESCE(l.simulated,0)!=i.paid_cents-i.refund_cents-i.fee_cents)) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('MERCHANT:',a.merchant_id) payment_no,a.debt_cents paid_cents,COALESCE(r.refund_debt,0)-COALESCE(b.offsets,0) refund_cents,0 fee_cents FROM settlement_account a LEFT JOIN (SELECT merchant_id,-SUM(simulated_delta) refund_debt FROM settlement_ledger WHERE entry_type='POST_SETTLEMENT_REFUND' GROUP BY merchant_id) r ON r.merchant_id=a.merchant_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT merchant_id,SUM(debt_offset_cents) offsets FROM settlement_batch GROUP BY merchant_id) b ON b.merchant_id=a.merchant_id WHERE a.debt_cents!=COALESCE(r.refund_debt,0)-COALESCE(b.offsets,0)
